instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium full shot. On a snowy winter sidewalk next to a building, the woman in the red puffer jacket (R1) walks on the left, holding a red phone and gesturing with her other hand as she smiles at her companion. Beside her, the woman in the light gray puffer jacket (R2) walks on the right, looking back and smiling. They walk side-by-side in friendly conversation. Bright daylight with soft backlighting illuminates the scene, creating a cool winter palette contrasted by the vibrant red outfit.
